newsitem.title: USA: Concorde Gaming to purchase casino assets.
newsitem.headline: Concorde Gaming to purchase casino assets.

text.p: Concorde Gaming Corp said Tuesday it has entered into an asset-purchase agreement with the Cripple Creek Development Corp, which has the Gold Rush Casino in Cripple Creek, Colorado, as its principal business.
Concorde will buy the casino and other assets for $8 million in cash, the assumption of $3.7 million in liabilities, and the issuance of 2.5 million shares of Concorde stock.

Conditions to the agreement are Concorde's licensing by the Colorado Gaming Commission, the company obtaining all necessary financing, due diligence review and Bankruptcy Court approval, Concorde said.
Cripple Creek filed for bankruptcy protection on October 17, 1996 as a result of a dispute among its shareholders and currently is operating as a debtor in possession, Concorde said.
